integrity.computational_scope: Four primes checked exhaustively; enumeration is not an infinite proof
integrity.proof_domain: All primes, with a characteristic-two case included
integrity.proof_type: Finite field reduction classes and elementary lifting counts

scientific_limitations: Only degree-at-most-two coefficient triples modulo the square of a prime are classified.
The coefficient vector is conditioned on being nonzero; distinct triples are not identified as polynomial functions.
High-moment asymptotics hold for each fixed integer order, not uniformly in growing orders.
Potential historical priority coverage by a more general unlocated finite-ring count theorem is unresolved.
title: Exact quadratic local root law modulo a prime square
